text: ワイヤレスアダプタを　つかった　あそびかたに　ついて

structure.jp: ワイヤレスアダプタを　つかった　あそびかたに
structure.en: ways to play that use the Wireless Adapter

patterns.name: 〜について
patterns.span: あそびかたに　ついて
patterns.explanation: について after a thing means 'about' that thing. あそびかたに　ついて = 'about how to play'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ワイヤレスアダプタを　つかった　あそびかた
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' or 'which' in English. ワイヤレスアダプタを　つかった　あそびかた = 'ways to play that use the Wireless Adapter'.

patterns.name: 〜方
patterns.explanation: かた added to the front part of a verb means 'the way of doing' it. あそびかた = 'how to play'.
